name: local-ai-command-center
description: Local AI Command Center — a professional control console for local LLM inference (Ollama) with an agent runtime, tools, and system monitoring.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lacc/shared && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lacc/backend" "npm run dev -w @lacc/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lacc/shared && npm run build -w @lacc/backend && npm run build -w @lacc/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lacc/backend && npm run test -w @lacc/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lacc/backend && npm run lint -w @lacc/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lacc/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lacc/backend && npm run typecheck -w @lacc/frontend
